g.text: The construction challenge differs by technology
One historical year compared with average fleet growth needed over 2024–2050. Each panel has its own scale.
Source: IEA WEO 2025, Tables A.3b/c (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); calculations use the same capacity definitions within each technology.
These are NET fleet changes, not gross construction. Replacements, repowering and retirements increase the build requirement.
A 26-year average is not a forecast for each year; 2024 is a reference year, not a permanent production limit.
